description: This Java class implements a service for managing credit reports within the Fineract microfinance platform. It handles operations such as fetching, adding, and deleting credit reports, primarily integrating with an external credit bureau named ThitsaWorks. The class manages data validation, persistence, and external communication related to credit reports.

classes.name: CreditReportWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CreditReportWritePlatformService interface, providing methods to fetch, add, save, and delete credit reports, mainly for external credit bureau integration in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: getCreditReport
methods.description: Fetches a credit report from the external credit bureau ThitsaWorks for a given creditBureauID, processes validation, and returns the report data as a CommandProcessingResult.

methods.name: addCreditReport
methods.description: Adds a new credit report for a specified credit bureau, validating the bureau and delegating the report addition to the external integration service.

methods.name: saveCreditReport
methods.description: Saves a credit report in local database, replacing existing reports if necessary, based on the nationalId and creditBureauId provided.

methods.name: deleteCreditReport
methods.description: Deletes a credit report identified by nationalId for a given creditBureauId.
